testcase.name: a 404 yields a clear not-ok health result and is not retried()
concurrent fetches never overlap on the wire()
consecutive fetches are spaced by the minimum interval()
a 429 is retried after a backoff and the retry succeeds()
the fetch result is complete for all five fixtures()
a 200 with zero bytes is reported rather than parsed as an empty page()
a 503 is treated as a rate limit not as a hard failure()
the request is the permitted url with the Referer the page requires()
other non-2xx codes are terminal and reported()
a throwing transport is retried and then surfaced as health not as an exception()
a transport that throws once then succeeds recovers()
Retry-After wins over the computed backoff()
